name: goap_multi_example_composition
mechanism: plan(goal_facts) (hosts.rs's plan_facts) already accepts an arbitrary LIST of goal facts and searches (uniform-cost/Dijkstra) until ALL are simultaneously satisfied. This experiment tests -- and confirms -- that this existing capability already composes ONE shared, generic, id-parameterized action across SEVERAL INDEPENDENT input->output examples in a single plan() call, rather than needing to be solved/verified per example the way the relational induction searches (synth3/synth4) have to be.
given_background: ONE generic primitive action 'decrement' (preconds counter(Id,X)+pred1(X,X2), effects: del counter(Id,X), add counter(Id,X2)) -- authored as a given primitive, same status as pred1/plus in the earlier relational search experiments, not a solution to the 3-counter composition problem itself.
experiment: 3 independent starting counters (a=3, b=5, c=2), single plan() call with goal = all three at 0 simultaneously.
result: Plan found: exactly 10 steps (3+5+2, no shortcut/combined-action shortcut exists in the given primitive set), every step a 'decrement(...)' instance, genuinely interleaved across ids a/b/c (not solved sequentially per-id) -- e.g. plan interleaves a,a,c,c,b,b,b,b,b,a rather than grouping all of a's steps then all of b's, confirming this was found by real cost-based search across the combined goal, not three separate sub-plans concatenated.
provenance: direct response to user's own idea: 'I definitely think the goap way is the approach, but we need to get it to be able to solve across multiple simultaneous input set to output set mappings. Which, again, is something I think we can achieve...' and 'maybe goap operating on a list of lists of inputs?' -- confirmed this multi-example composition capability already exists in plan()'s own semantics (a list of goal facts checked jointly), just not previously exercised/proven with genuinely independent simultaneous examples.
scope_note: This demonstrates the COMPOSITION mechanism (multiple simultaneous goals in one plan() call) works. It does NOT yet demonstrate deriving a NEW reusable named function/loop construct from this (e.g. registering 'decrement_to_zero' as a callable action in its own right) -- that packaging step is a natural next slice, not yet attempted.
related: spec_library/synthesized_registry/sum_of_evens_up_to_n_via_toggle_search.meta.json (the toggle/accumulator search this follows), friendly_cli/lib/goap_relevance.patlang (the earlier GOAP relevance-filter infrastructure this builds on)
